messages.subject: Location of temporary files
parts:
Hi,

 I'm using Wallace 1.9 on a shared windows machine. Each user has limited space. I tried to do projections on different circulation models CCSM and MIROC for Holocene and LGM, but at some point Wallace crashed due to lack of disk space.

 I was wondering, where does Wallace store  temporary files?  Is it possible to delete these environmental files and keep Wallace running?

thanks,

Eric,
